questions.prompt: The Cuyahoga River has salty water.
questions.evidenceSnippet:
Many animals call the Cuyahoga River
home. It is a fresh-water habitat. Ocean water
has salt, but the river does not.

questions.prompt: What do the wood ducks eat?
questions.evidenceSnippet:
A family of wood ducks floats by. The
mother leads her ducklings along the river
bank. They eat plants that grow in the water.
The plants are called duckweed.

questions.prompt: Why does the turtle cover her eggs with dirt?
choices: to hide them from other animals
questions.evidenceSnippet:
When she finds a place, she digs a hole with
her back legs. She covers her eggs with dirt to
hide them from other animals.

questions.prompt: The story says that every living thing in nature needs and helps another.
questions.evidenceSnippet:
Every living thing is important in nature.
Each living thing needs and helps another.
Each plant and animal lives and then begins a
new cycle. Life in the river keeps going.
questions.evidenceHighlight: Each living thing needs and helps another.
